outline:
控制理論及應用簡介、線性空間及線性運算子、線性動態方程式及反應、可控制性可觀測性及穩定性、狀態回授及狀態預估、多變數I/O控制器設計及應用。
Introduction, Linear spaces and linear operators, linear dynamic equations, controllability, observability, stability analysis, state feedback and state estimation, multi-input multi-output systems, controller design and applications.
schedule:
Weeks 1~2: Introduction, Linear spaces and linear operators
Week 3: Linear dynamic equations
Weeks 4~5: Controllability, observability
Week 6: Stability analysis
Weeks 7~8: State feedback and state estimation
Week 9: Midterm exam
Weeks 10~12: Multi-input multi-output systems
Weeks 13~17: Controller design and applications
Week 18: Final presentation
